title: Minimum Domino Rotations For Equal Row
description: Find the minimum number of rotations to make all values in either the top or bottom row equal.
pseudocode:
1. candidates = [tops[0], bottoms[0]]
2. for val in candidates:
3.   rotations = check(val)
4.   if rotations != -1: return rotations
5. return -1

steps.note: Initialize candidates from the first domino: [2, 1]
Check candidate 2: count rotations to make top row all 2s
